olivia: Heads-up — we've got a decaf emergency. Someone drank the last decaf and left the box open :scream: Anyone got spare pods?

mike: oat please. Also FYI the microwave in the 3rd-floor kitchenette is making a weird grinding noise — someone opened the back earlier? :rotating_light: 
lina: that was me. I zapped a frozen burrito and it sparked. apologies. 
I put a sticky note 'DO NOT USE' but seems folks are ignoring.
dev-bot: Incident noted: microwave-3B flagged. EngFacilities ticket #3421 created — https://tickets.internal/3421
olivia: Thanks @dev-bot. Jamal if you can grab decaf + oat milk that'd be amazing. Budget: $15. I'll Venmo.
jamal: Got it. Also quick poll: who wants cookies vs fruit tomorrow? react with :cookie: or :apple: 
ava: (oops wrong channel)
ava: :cookie:
